basis: The ACC site footer calls it a responsible operating agency (executive agency) and its organisation page lists civil servant and public-service staff matters; the ministry page lists it among the ministry's affiliated organisations.
The Support page says LOOP was reestablished in May 2019 as a non-profit incorporated association run by a board of directors and LOOP's Friends donors.
The museum site footer lists the museum under the Amorepacific Corp company details and names Amorepacific Corp as host.

The ARKO history page says the council descends from a foundation set up in 1973 under the Culture and Arts Promotion Act and was refounded when the Act was revised in 2005; its organisation chart lists ARKO Art Center as one of its units.

The foundation page says the non-profit Ilmin Cultural Foundation was set up in 1994 in honour of the late Kim Sang-man and runs the museum, and the site footer names it as an incorporated foundation.
